bull.b: Returning to year-over-year Marketplace GOV growth indicates that the platform is regaining transaction momentum after a weaker period. Growth in Vivid Seats Properties and Private Label can strengthen marketplace scale, improve monetization opportunities, and support more durable demand generation.

The sharp adjusted EBITDA increase, alongside reduced fixed expenses, suggests management has improved the operating model and its ability to convert marketplace activity into earnings. If sustained, this efficiency can provide greater resilience and reinvestment capacity as transaction volumes recover.

Growing app participation can deepen customer engagement and create a more direct repeat-purchase channel within the marketplace. Profitable app growth and ongoing transaction-funnel improvements may support retention, reduce friction, and strengthen the platform’s long-term customer economics.

bear.b: The recent combination of declining revenue and deeply negative margins represents a material deterioration in the core earnings model. Until demand and profitability recover, losses can constrain investment, increase earnings volatility, and make the company more vulnerable to adverse event-market conditions.

Substantial operating and free-cash-flow burn reduces the internally generated resources available to fund product development, marketing, and customer support. Continued negative cash generation would increase reliance on external capital and make execution more dependent on restoring profitable marketplace growth.

The proposed debt-for-equity exchange could materially improve solvency, but existing shareholders would retain only about 20% of the post-transaction equity. That substantial dilution reduces their economic participation in any recovery and reflects the severity of the company’s capital-structure pressure.
